gen-gf-unkempt-gf-asta-sans: Asta Sans draws friendly, tubelike letters with an e you'd never mistake for a blot. And with Unkempt shouting above, it settles into steady reading line after line, unbothered.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-biz-udpgothic: Rough-hewn strokes of one constant thickness give Unkempt its loud, expressive voice. BIZ UDPGothic follows with lavishly spaced letters and clear channels into each round shape, so the two never crowd each other.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-cairo: Unkempt swaggers in loudly with unvarying line thickness and a t whose crossbar matches its stem. Cairo takes over below with a wide channel into every bowl, cleanly modern.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-gantari: Gantari reads like wire bent into words, approachable and contemporary, with wide c apertures that keep every letter easy to follow. Unkempt above it adds the expressive, commanding punch the page needs.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-gayathri: Loud meets gentle: Unkempt keeps horizontals matching its verticals, while Gayathri lets a mild letterpress-slug variation into its curves. That gap between flat and gently modulated lines is what carries it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-gothic-a1: Gothic A1 is approachable, with a splayed c terminal that gives it character. Beneath Unkempt and its sign-painter's-stencil flatness, it keeps paragraphs moving at a steady, comfortable, unhurried pace.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-gotu: Gotu has hairlines of reasonable sturdiness and e crossbars with open mouths. Gotu stays lightly modulated without harsh thin spots, a gentle counterweight to the stencil-cut constancy of Unkempt.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-gruppo: Gruppo reads clean and professional, its curve endings never getting near each other, so lines feel light and unhurried. Unkempt earns its keep big and short, where its unthinned curves can shout.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: IBM Plex Sans KR reads modern and contemporary, with openness at every curve end that keeps text feeling light. Unkempt keeps full weight at its shoulders, so headings land loudly above.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: IBM Plex Sans Thai points the two ends of its c apart like open pincers. IBM Plex Sans Thai handles quiet running text, while Unkempt does its best work as plain, loud signage-like headlines.
